Warren County Fiscal Court
Meeting Minutes
October 15, 2026
Pursuant to adjournment, Warren Fiscal Court met on Thursday, October 15, 2026
at 9:00 AM in the Warren County Fiscal Courtroom at 429 E 10th Avenue, Bowling
Green, Kentucky. Present were: Esquire Eric Aldridge, Esquire Ron Cummings,
Esquire Scott Lasley, Esquire Tom Lawrence, Esquire Rex McWhorter, and
Esquire Rick Williams. Presiding Judge Executive Doug Gorman.
**********
Invocation by Magistrate Ron Cummings.
**********
Esquire Aldridge led the pledge to the flag.
**********
Esquire McWhorter moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve minutes of
the Fiscal Court meeting on September 24, 2026 and special-called fiscal court
meeting on September 29, 2026. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is
so ordered. (4)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve personnel
changes for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered. (5)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve work schedule
for the Warren County Road Department. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas,
no nays. It is so ordered. (6)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve second and
final reading of Ordinance #26-22WC Adopting an Animal Control Policy in
Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered.
(See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 589-A-1). (7)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to approve Warren
County Regional Jail Canteen Account financial report for August 2026. Upon roll
call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (8)
**********
Esquire Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve
Memorandum of Agreement between the Kentucky Division of Emergency
Management and Warren County Fiscal Court for the 2026 Rescue Aid Fund Grant
in the amount of $13,022.77 and authorize Judge Executive to execute all related
documents. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See
Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 589-B-5). (9)
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to grant Judge Executive
authority to execute 2027 Litter Abatement Grant funding application and all
related documents. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered.
(See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 590-A-1). (10)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve determination
in the amount of $5,500.80 to KACo for addition of SKYPAC Annex Building to the
County’s Insurance. (Contracted Vendor). Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas,
no nays. It is so ordered. (11)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to accept quarterly
financial reports from Alvaton, Browning, Gott, and Smiths Grove Fire
Departments. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (12)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve
reimbursement to the County Clerk in the amount of $8,742.15 for preparation of
the 2026 Real Estate Property Tax bills. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no
nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 590-B-4). (13)
**********
Esquire Williams moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to approve Interfund
Transfers for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is
so ordered. (14)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to authorize Judge Executive
to execute Service Agreement with Living Hope Baptist Church for use of gym
space for the upcoming 2026-2027 youth basketball league. Upon roll call the vote
was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp.
240, 590-C-1). (15)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve Order #26-40
Declaring Surplus Equipment for the Department of Public Safety. Upon roll call
the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21,
Supp. 240, 590-D). (16)
**********
Esquire Williams moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to approve Order #26-41
Declaring Surplus Equipment for Parks and Rec. Upon roll call the vote was: seven
yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 590-E).
(17)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to approve 211 Report for
September 2026. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered.
(18)
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve Order #26-42
Appointing Jim Page to the Bowling Green ITA Board of Directors. Upon roll call
the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21,
Supp. 240, 591-A). (19)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to approve determination
in the amount of $47,922.00 to Freedom Dodge of Lexington for a 2027 RAM 1500
Crew CAB for Drug Taskforce. (State Price Contract). Upon roll call the vote was:
seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (20)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve first reading of
Ordinance #26-23 Relating to the Annual Budget and Amendment Thereof. Upon
roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (21)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve budget
transfers for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is
so ordered. (22)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to accept bid from Caveland
Environmental in the amount of $121,380 for a 24-month agreement for portable
toilets and wash stations for Parks and Rec. (Publicly advertised. Only bid
received.). Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (23)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to accept bid from Clark
Beverage Group for a 24-month agreement for vending machines with 30% of gross
profit being returned to Parks. (Publicly advertised. Only bid received.) Upon roll
call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (24)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to approve determination in
the amount of $12,392.66 to Atek Electric and Mechanical for lighting installation
for the parking structure. (Three quotes requested. Two received. Lowest and best.)
Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (25)
**********
Esquire Williams moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve determination in
the amount of $8,039.10 to CED Bowling Green for purchase of light fixtures for the
parking structure. (Three quotes requested. Two received. Lowest and best.) Upon
roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (26)
**********
Esquire McWhorter moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve Order #26-43
Appointing Jim Page to the South Central Kentucky Regional Development
Authority (RDA). Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered.
(See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 592-A). (27)
**********
Esquire Williams moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to approve Order #26-44
Appointing Members to the Fire Department Executive Steering Committee. Upon
roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order
Book 21, Supp. 240, 592-B). (28)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to grant Judge Executive
authority to execute the Statewide Emergency Management Mutal Aid and
Assistance Agreement with the Commonwealth of Kentucky. Upon roll call the vote
was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp.
240, 592-C-8). (29)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve first reading of
Ordinance #26-24WC Authorizing a Lighting Agreement Between Warren Rural
Electric Cooperative Corporation and Bridleton Farms Subdivision. Upon roll call
the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (30)
**********
Magistrates present were given a copy of claims to be paid and after examination of
all claims the following motion was made: Esquire Cummings moved seconded by
Esquire Aldridge to approve claims as submitted. Upon roll call the vote was: seven
yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (31)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge that court adjourn to meet
again on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 9:00 AM. It is so ordered.
______________________________________
DOUGLAS J. GORMAN
WARREN COUNTY JUDGE EXECUTIVE
